title: ShaoZhi21/inference-engineering
summary: ShaoZhi21/inference-engineering项目从神经网络基础到生产级LLM服务，涵盖了transformers、KV缓存、量化、微调和推理优化等技术。该项目利用Python语言实现，适用于需要高性能推理和优化的场景。
description: From neural network fundamentals to production LLM serving — transformers, KV cache, quantization, fine-tuning, and inference optimization.
